_note: Central registry of every photograph on the site. Pages reference slots by name ({{#images.slot.available}} … {{{images.slot.picture}}} … {{/images.slot.available}}); a slot renders only when its graded files exist in public/images/, otherwise the page keeps its typographic composition. To add a photograph: put the licensed master in assets/source/ under the slot's 'master' name, run `python3 tools/grade-images.py`, then `node tools/image-inventory.mjs`. Focal points are 'x% y%' object positions. Licence details go in 'credit'.
